welcome: More reliable party quest syncing, smoother settings changes and cleaner compatibility handling.

sections.title: Party quest syncing
items: Fixed recovery when a quest-list reply is lost or stops partway through, which could leave a party member showing Loading for several minutes. This covers both parents receiving a child’s quests and children receiving their parents’ quests, including Kid mode.

sections.title: Settings and maps
items: Changing which players appear on your maps no longer unnecessarily restarts outgoing location subscriptions or rebroadcasts your location and partner status.
Applying presets or switching profiles now avoids repeated refreshes of map pins, the map button and the Data Broker launcher.

sections.title: Compatibility and maintenance
items: Native integrations now check the functions and safety support available in the game instead of requiring a particular client version.
Consolidated internal state handling and removed duplicate and unused code. Your existing settings are preserved.
